name: SONAIR benchmark-v1 real runs (public part)
source: cell platform folder SONAIRCrossite33/bench_runs (originals unchanged; SHA-256 of each in index.csv)

benchmark-v1.label: campaign session 0: the benchmark-v1 runs scored on the benchmark site, repeats r00 and r03

trial-1.label: campaign session 1: trial session, repeats r01 and r04

trial-2.label: campaign session 2: trial session, repeat r02

benchmark_v1_official: session benchmark-v1 only (108 runs: 72 published, 36 held-out), as on the benchmark site; trial-1 and trial-2 are kept for repeatability studies
withheld: measured channels of held-out runs (hidden targets)
raw ur_logs and imu_logs (cover held-out periods)
